limits: Original published order is preserved; it gives weight ordering, not numerical frequencies.

Inherited Training/Clan membership references expand source membership only, not a numerical weighting contract.
Same-name built-ins are not proof of missing downloaded per-map overrides.
All final2010 membership, hidden weights and unrecovered option bytes remain unresolved.
